projection.purpose: Translate universal principles into scoped local checks.

contract.input: Pinned Constitution, local profile and development legislation.
contract.step: Map a rule to its source, scope, implementation and evidence.
Record stack overrides rather than forcing one language.
contract.invariant: Technical evidence does not replace human adoption or editorial acceptance.

test.given: The game uses C++ while another consumer uses JavaScript.
test.when: Each declares its local profile and checks.
test.then: Both may preserve the method without sharing an implementation language.
